+        x, y, z = tcp_xyz
+        ee = self.ee[arm].copy()
+        ee[:3] = (x, y - APPROACH_GAP, z)
+        ee[3:7] = self.q[arm]

+    def send(self, label, active_arm=None, tcp_xyz=None, grip=None, video="none"):
+        row = np.empty(16, dtype=np.float32)

+            else:
+                row[arm * 8:arm * 8 + 7] = self.ee[arm]
+                row[arm * 8 + 7] = float(self.now[28 + arm])

+            self.ee = [self.now[14:21].copy(), self.now[21:28].copy()]
+            self.q = [self.ee[0][3:7].copy(), self.ee[1][3:7].copy()]
+        else:
+            # A result without a fresh proprio snapshot still records the requested pose.
+            if active_arm is not None:
+                self.ee[active_arm] = row[active_arm * 8:active_arm * 8 + 7].astype(float)

+                          "reason": res.meta.get("reason"), "plan": res.meta.get("plan"),
+                          "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s")}), flush=True)
+        if res.meta.get("done"):

+        self.q = [self.ee[0][3:7].copy(), self.ee[1][3:7].copy()]

+        b = BLOCKS[name]
+        arm = b["arm"]
+        x, y, z = b["pick"]
+        px, py = b["place"]
+        # Move above the near-side grasp point, descend, and close around the block.

+        self.send(f"{name}_grasp", arm, (x, y, z), 1.0)
+        self.send(f"{name}_close", arm, (x, y, z), 0.0)
+        self.observe(f"after_{name}_grasp")

+        self.send(f"{name}_carry", arm, (px, py, LIFT_Z), 0.0)
+        self.send(f"{name}_place", arm, (px, py, z), 0.0)
+        self.send(f"{name}_release", arm, (px, py, z), 1.0)
+        self.send(f"{name}_retreat", arm, (px, py, LIFT_Z), 1.0)
